name: Echoes of Saturn
source:
Echoes of Saturn is a 2D visual novel centred around Saturn Aczél (they/them), a 23yo art student, as they navigate through a difficult visit to their hometown, following the death of their grandfather. Having to attend the funerals, they are confronted with memories from their childhood, and must then manage their mental health as they are faced with trauma from their past.

[From [url=https://therubyjailcell.itch.io/eos-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《土星的回响》是一部2D视觉小说，以23岁的艺术学生Saturn Aczél（他们/他们）为中心，在祖父去世后，他们经历了一次艰难的家乡之旅。他们必须参加葬礼，面对童年的记忆，然后必须管理自己的心理健康，因为他们面临着过去的创伤。

[来自[url=https://therubyjailcell.itch.io/eos-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
